sentences.text: The main prayer in these writ petitions is for granting compensation for the entire structure even though a portion alone been acquired.
The issue is covered by the judgments of this Court in WPC.No.14715 of 2024 and WA Nos.718 of 2024 and connected cases.
In the above circumstances, these writ petitions are closed with liberty to the petitioners to move the arbitrator for appropriate relief as has been directed in the above said judgments.
The petitioners will be entitled to move an application under Section 17 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act in these cases if required.

Sd/-
